Remark
[Ricci and scalar curvature in index notation]

Source: petersen:page-0108 ↗ def:pet-ch3-ricci-curvature ↗ def:pet-ch3-scalar-curvature ↗ prop:pet-ch3-curvature-coordinate-formula

1. ch3:3.1.7In coordinates one writes $\operatorname {Ric}_{ij}=R_{ij}=R^k_{ik}=g^{kl}R_{kijl}$ and $\operatorname {scal}=R=g^{ij}R_{ij}$, both obtained by contracting indices of the curvature tensor; to avoid confusing the full curvature tensor with the scalar curvature it is also denoted $\mathfrak {Rm}$.
